dspy_run.reason: The current build container cannot reach package registries or model-provider APIs. This artifact is intentionally not represented as DSPy-generated.

architecture_decisions: Use Expo SDK 57 / React Native 0.86 as the universal client foundation.
Use React Native Skia for the living material surface, optical head, and animated Parallax Lens Mark while preserving normal Text for accessible message content.
Use FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + DSPy as the intelligence/persistence service.
Keep protected metrics outside DSPy optimizer-controlled modules.
Use Luna -> Terra -> Sol as the runtime escalation order.

work_items.summary: Build the living surface, calm lens mark, and response-state motion mapping.
Build the optical laser typesetter with normal accessible text.
Build durable conversation persistence and multi-turn service contracts.
Build DSPy program boundaries, protected metrics, and Luna/Terra/Sol routing.
Add responsive shell and validation workflows.

risks: React Native Skia web requires CanvasKit WASM to be available before registration.
The initial optical head maps generation progress across the response container rather than true per-glyph geometry; visual QA is required before production promotion.
A real DSPy compile/optimization pass still requires a provider-enabled environment and must be reviewed before it can replace this bootstrap plan.
Package lockfiles are not yet generated in the offline build container.
